paths.summary_en: A civic decision is delivered to Orgo; results return without merging the two owners’ states.
Source evidence and references cross separate ownership boundaries before being read in an authorized context.
An authorized selection feeds editorial composition; language realization remains an independent optional input.

Koali brings autonomous systems together; an approved resource may be published to UCKK through explicit governed exchange, preserving evidence, rights and receipts. This is a composition path, not a monolith or automatically qualified publication.
